rationale: Three minutes after entry, the bearish thesis remains intact as GE continues to trade firmly below both declining session VWAP ($298.28) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($298.68). A minor 1-minute bounce to $298.15 was quickly rejected on the subsequent bar, which pushed down to a new post-entry low of $296.66 on expanding volume. With relative weakness persisting against a positive SPY (+0.32%) and our invalidation level ($299.20) well above key intraday resistance, holding for a retest of the session low ($294.22) remains the highest-expectancy play.
